reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis overstates the stabilizing effect of lattice distortion; in Al–Co–Cr–Fe–Ni, higher Al content is well-known to promote BCC/B2 phase formation, not stabilize a single FCC phase, which contradicts the predicted outcome.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and well-structured, with a direct falsification criterion linking Al content to lattice distortion and phase stability, though the expected outcome is physically incorrect.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it predicts a trend (FCC stabilization with Al) that is opposite to established phase diagrams, so testing it would not advance understanding of phase stability in this system.
